<script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(event) {
        var buttonOk = document.getElementById("cookie-banner-ok");
        var buttonInfo = document.getElementById("cookie-banner-info");
        
        buttonOk.addEventListener("click", function() {
            setCookieBannerCookie();
            location.reload();
        });
        
        /*buttonInfo.addEventListener("click", function() {
            setCookieBannerCookie();
            location.reload();
        })*/
    });
    
    function setCookieBannerCookie() {
        var cookieName = "cookieBannerCookie";
        var baseDomain = ".targobank.de";
        var cookieLifetime = 180; //Lifetime in days
        
        
        var expireAfter = new Date();
        expireAfter.setDate(expireAfter.getDate() + cookieLifetime);
        
        
        document.cookie=cookieName +"=1; domain=" + baseDomain + "; expires=" + expireAfter + "; path=/";
    }
</script>
